2368.n: TREE: οὗτος is the subject of εἰδείη, not of εἴη.
2368.r: οὗτος … εἰδείη “he it is who would feel”: οὗτος resumes ὁ μάλιστα λυπούμενος as subject of εἰδείη [SMYTH:1251] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:144].

2370.r: καὶ λαβὼν τὴν ἀρχήν “if he should recover the throne”: a circumstantial participle, καί correlative with the preceding clause [SMYTH:2060] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:144]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2371.r: Article with the abstract noun ἀρχὴν [SMYTH:1131].

2373.r: Agrees with χάριν and takes its case function [MORPH].

2375.r: σοι χάριν εἰδείη “would feel gratitude toward you”: the dative of the person with χάριν οἶδα [CONV:R42].

2377.r: Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH]. Potential optative with ἄν [SMYTH:1824].

2382.r: εἴ τι … μέλει “if you care at all”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

2383.r: σοι … μέλει “you care”: the dative with the impersonal μέλει [CONV:R18].

2385.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2387.r: μέλει “it is a care”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2389.n: TREE: τοῦ belongs to καταλιπεῖν, not to τεταραγμένα.
2389.r: τοῦ … καταλιπεῖν “leaving”: the article of the articular infinitive [SMYTH:2025].

2391.r: ὡς ἥκιστα “as little as possible”: the superlative adverb with ὡς [SMYTH:1086].

2392.r: ὡς ἥκιστα τεταραγμένα τάδε καταλιπεῖν “to leave matters here in as little confusion as possible”: the predicate participle agreeing with τάδε [CONV:R5] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Passive: the subject is acted on [SMYTH:1735].

2394.r: τοῦ … καταλιπεῖν “leaving”: the articular infinitive in the genitive with μέλει [SMYTH:2032] [SMYTH:1356]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2397.r: Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH]. Subjunctive in a subordinate clause [CONV:D6].

2399.r: σκόπει “consider”: the imperative [SMYTH:1835]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2401.r: ἔφη “he added”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2405.r: ἂν οἴει “do you think”: the present; ἄν belongs to ἔχειν [SMYTH:1875] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. οἴομαι “think” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2407.r: ἂν οἴει ἠρεμεστέρως ἔχειν “do you think would be in a more tranquil state”: the infinitive with ἄν stands for a potential optative [CONV:R53] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. Active voice [MORPH].

2408.n: TREE: τὰ ἐνθάδε is the subject of ἔχειν, not its object.
2408.r: τὰ ἐνθάδε “the country here”: the article makes the adverb a noun [SMYTH:1153].

2410.r: Agrees with ἀρχῆς and takes its case function [MORPH].

2411.r: καινῆς γενομένης ἀρχῆς “under a new administration”: a conditional genitive absolute, = εἰ καινὴ γένοιτο ἀρχή [SMYTH:2070] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].

2414.r: The article makes εἰωθυίας a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2415.r: τῆς εἰωθυίας “the accustomed one”: the participle used attributively, ἀρχῆς understood [SMYTH:2049]. Genitive absolute with καταμενούσης [SMYTH:2070]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2416.r: τῆς εἰωθυίας καταμενούσης “if the one we are used to should continue”: a conditional genitive absolute [SMYTH:2070]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2420.r: εἴ τι … μέλει “if you care at all”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

2421.r: σοι μέλει “you care”: the dative with the impersonal μέλει [CONV:R18].

2422.r: μέλει “it is a care”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2424.r: The article turns the infinitive ἐξάγειν into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

2426.r: Agrees with στρατιὰν and takes its case function [MORPH].

2428.r: τοῦ … ἐξάγειν “taking with you”: the articular infinitive in the genitive with μέλει [SMYTH:2032]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2430.n: TREE: τίνα is the subject of ἐξετάσαι, ταύτην its object.
2430.r: τίνʼ … ἐξετάσαι “who would organize”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972].

2432.r: οἴει “do you think”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. οἴομαι “think” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2434.r: τίνʼ ἂν οἴει … ἐξετάσαι “who do you think would organize”: the infinitive with ἄν stands for a potential optative [CONV:R53]. Active voice [MORPH].

2435.n: TREE: ταύτην is the object of ἐξετάσαι, not its subject.
2435.r: ἐξετάσαι ταύτην “organize it”: the object of ἐξετάσαι [SMYTH:1553].

2437.r: The article makes κεχρημένου a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2439.r: αὐτῇ κεχρημένου “who has employed it”: χράομαι takes the dative [SMYTH:1509]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2440.n: TREE: κεχρημένου depends on μᾶλλον, not on τίνα; the lemma should be χράομαι.
2440.r: μᾶλλον … τοῦ πολλάκις αὐτῇ κεχρημένου “better than he who has often employed them”: the genitive of comparison [SMYTH:1431]; the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:2050]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859].

2445.r: χρημάτων δεήσει “there will be need of money”: δεῖ takes the genitive of the thing needed [SMYTH:1400].

2446.r: Future indicative of a coming event [MORPH]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2448.n: TREE: τίνα is the subject of ἐκπορίσαι, not its object.
2448.r: τίνʼ … ἐκπορίσαι “who could supply”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972].

2451.r: νομίζεις “do you think”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2452.r: κρεῖττον “better”: the comparative used as an adverb [SMYTH:1609].

2453.r: τίνʼ ἂν … νομίζεις … ἐκπορίσαι “who do you think could supply”: the infinitive with ἄν stands for a potential optative [CONV:R53]. Active voice [MORPH].

2454.r: The article makes καὶ a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2456.r: κρεῖττον … τοῦ καὶ εἰδότος “better than he who knows”: the genitive of comparison [SMYTH:1431]; the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:2050]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2458.r: καὶ ἔχοντος “and commands”: the genitive of comparison, coordinate with εἰδότος [SMYTH:1431]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2459.r: Agrees with ὄντα and takes its case function [MORPH].

2460.r: The article makes ὄντα a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2461.n: TREE: τὰ ὄντα is the object of εἰδότος/ἔχοντος, not of κρεῖττον.
2461.r: πάντα τὰ ὄντα “all the resources”: the object of εἰδότος and ἔχοντος [SMYTH:1553] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH]. Attributive or substantival participle [SMYTH:2049].

2465.r: ἔφη “he added”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2469.r: φύλαξαι “beware”: the middle φυλάττομαι “be on one’s guard” [SMYTH:1719] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Imperative of command [SMYTH:1835].

2472.r: ἀποβαλών “in casting aside”: a circumstantial participle of means [SMYTH:2063] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. Agrees with the subject of ζημιώσῃς [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2473.n: TREE: σαυτόν is the object of ζημιώσῃς, not of ἀποβαλών.
2473.r: σαυτὸν ζημιώσῃς “do yourself injury”: the object of ζημιώσῃς [SMYTH:1553].

2474.r: φύλαξαι μὴ … ζημιώσῃς “beware lest you injure”: μή with the subjunctive after a verb of caution [CONV:D6]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2475.r: ζημιώσῃς πλείω “injure more”: the internal accusative [SMYTH:1573] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173].

2477.r: Particular article: πατὴρ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2479.r: Aorist indicative stating a single past event [SMYTH:1923]. δύναμαι “be able” is middle-only and fits none of the middle types well; the case is still open [CONV:D3] [CONV:R3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2480.n: TREE: σε is the object of βλάψαι, not its subject.
2480.r: σε βλάψαι “harm you”: the object of βλάψαι [SMYTH:1553].

2481.r: ἐδυνήθη βλάψαι “was able to harm”: δύναμαι with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:2000]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2483.r: The article as a pronoun, with μέν or δέ [SMYTH:1106].

2486.r: ἔλεγεν “spoke”: the imperfect of a speech [SMYTH:1890]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2488.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

2491.r: ἀκούων “at hearing him”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of ὑπερήδετο [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2492.r: ὑπερήδετο “was more than pleased”: ὑπερήδομαι, a middle of emotion [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2495.r: ἐνόμιζε “he thought”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2496.r: ἐνόμιζε περαίνεσθαι “thought was in course of accomplishment”: the present infinitive of indirect discourse [CONV:D7]; passive [SMYTH:1735].

2497.n: TREE: πάντα is the subject of περαίνεσθαι, not its object.
2497.r: πάντα … περαίνεσθαι “that everything was being accomplished”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972].

2498.r: περαίνεσθαι … αὐτῷ “accomplished for him”: the dative of advantage [SMYTH:1481]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2500.r: Aorist indicative stating a single past event [SMYTH:1923]. ὑπισχνέομαι is middle-only, a speech-act middle [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2501.r: Article with the proper name Κυαξάρῃ [SMYTH:1136].

2502.n: TREE: Κυαξάρῃ depends on ὑπέσχετο, not on πράξειν.
2502.r: ὑπέσχετο τῷ Κυαξάρῃ “had promised Cyaxares”: the indirect object of ὑπισχνέομαι [SMYTH:1469].

2503.r: ὑπέσχετο … πράξειν “promised to do”: the future infinitive after a verb of promising [SMYTH:1868]. Active voice [MORPH].

2505.r: ἐμέμνητο “he remembered”: the pluperfect of a perfect with present meaning [CONV:R6]. μέμνημαι, ἐμνήσθην “remember”: a middle of mental process [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2507.r: ἐμέμνητο … εἰπών “remembered having told”: the supplementary participle with a verb of remembering [SMYTH:2106]. Agrees with the subject of ἐμέμνητο [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2510.r: φίλον … ποιήσειν “would make his friend”: the predicate accusative, the object understood [CONV:R5].

2511.r: ὅτι … οἴοιτο “that he thought”: the optative in indirect discourse after a past tense [SMYTH:2619]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. οἴομαι “think” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

2515.r: οἴοιτο … ποιήσειν “thought he would make”: the future infinitive of indirect discourse [CONV:D7]. Active voice [MORPH].

2520.r: ἐκ τούτου “thereupon”: ἐκ with the genitive, of the time from which [PREP:ἐκ] [CONV:R31].

2522.r: The article makes Ἀρμένιον a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2524.r: ἐρωτᾷ “he asked”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2529.r: ταῦτα πείθωμαι ὑμῖν “I comply with you in this”: the internal accusative with πείθομαι [SMYTH:1573].

2530.r: ἢν … πείθωμαι “if I comply”: ἐάν with the subjunctive [SMYTH:2323] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:164]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. πείθομαι “obey, trust”: a middle of mental process; it can also be read as passive “be persuaded” [CONV:D3].

2531.r: πείθωμαι ὑμῖν “comply with you”: πείθομαι takes the dative [SMYTH:1464].

2533.r: λέγε “tell”: the imperative [SMYTH:1835]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2534.r: λέγε μοι “tell me”: the indirect object [SMYTH:1469].

2536.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2538.n: TREE: σύ belongs with λέγε, not with ἔφη.
2538.r: σύ, ὦ Ἀρμένιε “you, king of Armenia”: σύ in address, with the vocative [CONV:R117].

2543.r: Agrees with στρατιάν and takes its case function [MORPH].

2546.r: μοι συμπέμψεις “send with me”: the dative with a compound of σύν [SMYTH:1544].

2547.n: TREE: the indirect questions depend on λέγε, not on ἔφη.
2547.r: πόσην … συμπέμψεις “how large an army will you send”: the future, kept in the indirect question [SMYTH:2677]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2549.r: Agrees with χρήματα and takes its case function [MORPH].

2552.r: πόσα … συμβαλῇ “how much money will you contribute”: the future middle of συμβάλλω “contribute” [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2554.r: Article with the abstract noun πόλεμον [SMYTH:1131].

2555.r: εἰς τὸν πόλεμον “to the war”: εἰς with the accusative of purpose [PREP:εἰς] [CONV:R10].

2558.r: πρὸς ταῦτα “to this”: πρός with the accusative of what is answered [CONV:R51].

2560.r: λέγει “replied”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2561.r: The article makes Ἀρμένιος a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2564.n: TREE: οὐδέν is the object of εἰπεῖν, not of ἔχω.
2564.r: οὐδὲν ἔχω … εἰπεῖν “I have nothing to propose”: the object of εἰπεῖν [SMYTH:1553].

2565.r: ἔχω “I can”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2570.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2572.n: TREE: ἁπλούστερον agrees with οὐδέν; it is not a predicate of εἰπεῖν.
2572.r: οὐδὲν … ἁπλούστερον “nothing more simple”: the comparative agrees with οὐδέν [SMYTH:1020].

2573.r: ἔχω … εἰπεῖν “I can propose”: ἔχω “be able” with the infinitive [SMYTH:2000]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2576.r: οὐδὲ δικαιότερον “or more fair”: the comparative agrees with οὐδέν [SMYTH:1020].

2578.r: ἢ δεῖξαι “than to show”: the infinitive as the second member of the comparison [SMYTH:1071]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2581.r: Agrees with δύναμιν and takes its case function [MORPH].

2582.r: Article with the abstract noun δύναμιν [SMYTH:1131].

2583.r: πᾶσαν τὴν οὖσαν δύναμιν “all the forces I have”: the attributive participle [SMYTH:2049]. Agrees with δύναμιν and takes its case function [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2588.n: TREE: ἰδόντα depends on ἄγειν, not on δεῖξαι.
2588.r: σὲ δὲ ἰδόντα “and you, when you have seen them”: a temporal participle agreeing with σέ [SMYTH:2061]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2589.r: Agrees with στρατιὰν and takes its case function [MORPH].

2592.r: ἄν σοι δοκῇ “you see fit”: the dative with δοκεῖ [CONV:R18].

2593.r: ὅσην μὲν ἄν σοι δοκῇ “as many as you see fit”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a relative clause [SMYTH:2565]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2595.n: TREE: ἄγειν is coordinate with δεῖξαι, not dependent on δοκῇ.
2595.r: σὲ … ἄγειν “for you to take”: the infinitive coordinate with δεῖξαι [SMYTH:1071]. Active voice [MORPH].

2597.n: TREE: τὴν is the object of καταλιπεῖν, not an article of φυλακήν.
2597.r: τὴν δέ “the rest”: the article as a pronoun answering ὅσην μέν [SMYTH:1106] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173].

2599.n: TREE: καταλιπεῖν is coordinate with δεῖξαι, not dependent on δοκῇ.
2599.r: τὴν δὲ καταλιπεῖν “and to leave the rest”: the infinitive coordinate with δεῖξαι [SMYTH:1071]. Active voice [MORPH].

2600.r: Particular article: χώρας is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2601.r: τῆς χώρας φυλακήν “to protect the country”: the objective genitive [SMYTH:1331] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:145].

2602.r: καταλιπεῖν … φυλακήν “to leave as a defence”: the predicate accusative [CONV:R5] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:145].

2608.r: περὶ χρημάτων “in regard to the money”: περί with the genitive [PREP:περί] [CONV:R10].

2609.r: δηλῶσαι … δίκαιον “it is right to show”: the infinitive as subject of δίκαιον (ἐστί) [SMYTH:1984]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2611.n: TREE: ἐμέ is the subject of δηλῶσαι, not its object.
2611.r: ἐμὲ … δηλῶσαι “for me to show”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972].

2612.r: Predicate nominative with the verb understood [SMYTH:910].

2613.n: TREE: σοι depends on δηλῶσαι, not on δίκαιον.
2613.r: δηλῶσαι … σοι “to show to you”: the indirect object [SMYTH:1469].

2614.r: Agrees with ὄντα and takes its case function [MORPH].

2615.r: The article makes ὄντα a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2616.r: πάντα τὰ ὄντα “all that I have”: the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:2050] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:173]. Direct object of δηλῶσαι [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2618.n: TREE: σέ is the subject of φέρεσθαι and καταλιπεῖν, not the object of γνόντα.
2618.r: σὲ δὲ … φέρεσθαι “and for you to take”: the subject of the infinitives [SMYTH:1972].

2620.r: τούτων … ὁπόσα “as much of it”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

2621.r: σὲ … αὐτόν “you yourself”: the intensive αὐτός [SMYTH:1206].

2622.n: TREE: γνόντα depends on φέρεσθαι, not on δηλῶσαι.
2622.r: αὐτὸν γνόντα “deciding for yourself”: a circumstantial participle agreeing with σέ [SMYTH:2060]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2626.r: ὁπόσα … ἂν βούλῃ “as much as you please”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a relative clause [SMYTH:2565]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. βούλομαι “wish” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

2627.n: TREE: φέρεσθαι is coordinate with δηλῶσαι, not dependent on βούλῃ.
2627.r: φέρεσθαι “to take for yourself”: the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]; the infinitive coordinate with δηλῶσαι [SMYTH:1984]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

2631.r: ὁπόσα ἂν βούλῃ “as much as you please”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a relative clause [SMYTH:2565]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. βούλομαι “wish” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

2632.n: TREE: καταλιπεῖν is coordinate with φέρεσθαι, not dependent on βούλῃ.
2632.r: καταλιπεῖν “to leave”: the infinitive coordinate with φέρεσθαι [SMYTH:1984]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2636.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

2638.r: εἶπεν “said”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2640.r: ἴθι δή “come then”: the imperative of εἶμι, used as an interjection [SMYTH:1836]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4556.r: ὁρῶ … ἔχοντας ὥσπερ ἐγὼ ηὐχόμην “behold in just the condition I desired”: the supplementary participle with a verb of perception, ἔχω with an adverb [CONV:R4] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:183]. In indirect discourse the tense is that of the direct form [CONV:D7]. Active voice [MORPH].

4559.r: ηὐχόμην “I desired”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. εὔχομαι is middle-only, a speech-act middle [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4562.n: TREE: the postag should be p-s---na- (tree: p-s---nn-). TREE: τοῦτο is accusative, not nominative.
4562.r: τοῦτο ἐπίστω … ὅτι “believe me when I say that”: the object of ἐπίστω, anticipating the ὅτι clause [SMYTH:1553].

4563.r: ἐπίστω “be assured”: ἐπίσταμαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]; the imperative [SMYTH:1835]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

4565.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4573.n: TREE: the ὥστε clause depends on ἔδωκα, not on ἐπίστω.
4573.r: ὥστε ἀπελάσαι “to have driven”: ὥστε with the infinitive of a condition, serving as the protasis of ἂν ἔδωκα [SMYTH:2279] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:183]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4574.n: TREE: Χαλδαίους is the object of ἀπελάσαι; the subject is ἐγώ.
4574.r: ἀπελάσαι Χαλδαίους “to have driven the Chaldaeans”: the object of ἀπελάσαι [SMYTH:1553].

4576.r: Agrees with ἄκρων and takes its case function [MORPH].

4577.r: Particular article: ἄκρων is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

4578.r: Genitive with ἀπό, “from”: source or separation [PREP:ἀπό]; the tag gives the function of the phrase [CONV:D1].

4579.r: Agrees with χρήματα and takes its case function [MORPH].

4581.r: πολλαπλάσια ἂν ἔδωκα “I would have given many times as much”: ἄν with the aorist indicative of an unreal past apodosis [SMYTH:2303] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:183]. Active voice [MORPH].

4583.n: TREE: ὧν depends on πολλαπλάσια, not on ἔχεις.
4583.r: πολλαπλάσια … ὧν σὺ νῦν ἔχεις “many times as much as you now have”: the relative attracted into the genitive of comparison, for τούτων ἅ [CONV:R81] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:183].

4586.r: ἔχεις “you have”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4588.r: παρʼ ἐμοῦ “from me”: παρά with the genitive of source [PREP:παρά] [CONV:D1].

4592.r: ὑπισχνοῦ “you promised”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. ὑπισχνέομαι is middle-only, a speech-act middle [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4593.r: ὑπισχνοῦ ποιήσειν “promised to do”: the future infinitive after a verb of promising [SMYTH:1868]. Active voice [MORPH].

4594.r: ἃ … ἀγαθὰ ἡμᾶς “the benefit to us”: the thing done, its noun drawn into the relative clause [SMYTH:2536].

4595.r: ποιήσειν … ἡμᾶς “do to us”: the person, in a double accusative with ποιέω [SMYTH:1591].

4597.n: TREE: the ὅτε clause depends on ὑπισχνοῦ, not on ποιήσειν.
4597.r: ὅτʼ ἐλάμβανες “when you received”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4598.r: Particular article: χρήματα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

4601.r: ἀποτετέλεσται “has been conferred”: the perfect passive [SMYTH:1945]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4602.r: ἀποτετέλεσταί σοι “has been conferred by you”: the dative of agent with a perfect passive [SMYTH:1488].

4607.r: προσοφείλοντες … ἀναπεφήναμεν “we obviously owe besides”: the supplementary participle with φαίνομαι [CONV:R39]. Agrees with the subject of ἀναπεφήναμεν [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4608.r: προσοφείλοντές σοι “owing you”: the indirect object [SMYTH:1469].

4609.r: Agrees with χάριτας and takes its case function [MORPH].

4610.n: TREE: χάριτας is the object of προσοφείλοντες, not of ἀναπεφήναμεν.
4610.r: προσοφείλοντες … ἄλλας χάριτας “owing a new debt of gratitude”: the object of προσοφείλοντες [SMYTH:1553].

4611.r: ὥστε … ἀναπεφήναμεν “so that we obviously are”: the intransitive second perfect “have been shown”; ὥστε with the indicative of actual result [SMYTH:2274]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4613.n: TREE: ἅς is the object of ἀποδιδόντες, not of αἰσχυνοίμεθα.
4613.r: ἃς … ἀποδιδόντες “which … repaying”: the object of ἀποδιδόντες [SMYTH:1553].

4620.r: εἰ μὴ κακοί ἐσμεν “if we have not lost all self-respect”: the present; ironic, not the true protasis [SMYTH:2298] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:183]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4622.r: αἰσχυνοίμεθʼ ἄν “we should be ashamed”: the potential optative with ἄν [CONV:D6]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. αἰσχύνομαι “feel shame” is a middle of emotion (mental process) [CONV:D3].

4624.r: σοι … ἀποδιδόντες “repaying you”: the indirect object [SMYTH:1469].

4626.r: μὴ ἀποδιδόντες “if we did not repay”: a conditional participle, = εἰ μὴ ἀποδιδοῖμεν [SMYTH:2067] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:183] [COMM:de-breitenbach-1871-heft1:311]. Agrees with the subject of αἰσχυνοίμεθ’ [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4628.r: The article makes Ἀρμένιος a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

4632.r: ἔλεξεν “spoke”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4634.r: The article makes Χαλδαῖοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

4637.r: ἧκον “had come back”: the imperfect of ἥκω [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4638.r: δεόμενοι “with the request”: δέομαι “ask” [CONV:D3]; a circumstantial participle of purpose [SMYTH:2065]. Agrees with the subject of ἧκον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

4639.r: Article with the proper name Κύρου [SMYTH:1136].

4640.n: TREE: Κύρου depends on δεόμενοι, not on εἰρήνην.
4640.r: δεόμενοι τοῦ Κύρου “asking Cyrus”: δέομαι takes the genitive of the person [SMYTH:1398].

4642.r: εἰρήνην σφίσι ποιῆσαι “make peace with them”: the indirect reflexive, dative of interest [SMYTH:1481].

4643.r: δεόμενοι … ποιῆσαι “asking to make”: the infinitive after a verb of asking [SMYTH:1992]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4646.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

4648.r: ἐπήρετο “asked”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. ἐπέρομαι “ask” is middle-only, a speech-act middle; questioning can also be classed as reciprocal [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4649.r: Direct object of ἐπήρετο [MORPH]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

4651.n: TREE: the postag should be p-s---nn- (tree: p-s---na-). TREE: the idiom is nominative, not accusative.
4651.r: ἄλλο τι “is it aught else”: ἄλλο agrees with τι [SMYTH:1020] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:155].

4652.n: TREE: the postag should be p-s---nn- (tree: p-s---na-). TREE: τι is nominative, not the object of ἐπιθυμεῖτε.
4652.r: ἄλλο τι … ἢ τούτου ἕνεκα “is it for aught else than for this”: the idiomatic nominative, ἐστί understood [SMYTH:2652] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:155].

4654.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4660.r: τούτου ἕνεκα “for this reason”: ἕνεκα with the genitive [CONV:R10].

4662.n: TREE: εἰρήνης depends on ἐπιθυμεῖτε, not on ἕνεκα.
4662.r: εἰρήνης … ἐπιθυμεῖτε “desire peace”: ἐπιθυμέω takes the genitive [SMYTH:1349].

4664.r: ἐπιθυμεῖτε “you desire”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4666.r: νομίζετε “you think”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4667.r: ἀσφαλέστερον “in greater security”: the comparative used as an adverb [SMYTH:1609].

4669.r: νομίζετε … ἂν δύνασθαι “think you could”: the infinitive with ἄν stands for a potential optative [CONV:R53]. δύναμαι “be able” is middle-only and fits none of the middle types well; the case is still open [CONV:D3] [CONV:R3].

4670.r: δύνασθαι ζῆν “could live”: δύναμαι with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:2000]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4672.r: εἰρήνης γενομένης “if we had peace”: a conditional genitive absolute [SMYTH:2070]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].

4674.r: ἢ πολεμοῦντες “than if we were at war”: a conditional participle, nominative as agreeing with the subject of νομίζετε [SMYTH:2067] [SMYTH:1973]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4679.r: ἐπεὶ … ἔχομεν “since we are in possession”: the present in a causal clause [SMYTH:2240]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4682.r: ἔφασαν “assented”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4683.r: The article makes Χαλδαῖοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

4687.r: καὶ ὅς “and he”: ὅς as a demonstrative [SMYTH:1113].

4689.r: τί δʼ “and what”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

4692.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4696.r: Agrees with ἀγαθὰ and takes its case function [MORPH].

4697.r: ὑμῖν … προσγένοιτο “should accrue to you”: the dative with a compound of πρός [SMYTH:1544].

4699.r: εἰ … προσγένοιτο “if should accrue”: the optative in the protasis of a less vivid condition [SMYTH:2329]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. προσγίγνομαι is a compound of γίγνομαι, middle-only: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].

4701.r: Article with the abstract noun εἰρήνην [SMYTH:1131].

4702.r: διὰ τὴν εἰρήνην “as a result of the peace”: διά with the accusative of cause [PREP:διά] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:155].

4708.r: ἔφασαν “they answered”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4711.r: ἔτι ἄν … μᾶλλον εὐφραινοίμεθα “we should be still more pleased”: the potential optative with ἄν [CONV:D6]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. εὐφραίνομαι “be glad” is a middle of emotion (mental process) [CONV:D3].

4713.n: TREE: the postag should be p-s---nn- (tree: p-s---na-). TREE: the idiom ἄλλο τι ἤ is nominative.
4713.r: ἄλλο τι “for any other reason”: ἄλλο agrees with τι [SMYTH:1020].

4714.n: TREE: the postag should be p-s---nn- (tree: p-s---na-). TREE: τι is not the subject of εἶναι.
4714.r: ἄλλο τι … ἢ διὰ τό “is it for any other reason than because”: the idiomatic nominative, ἐστί understood [SMYTH:2652] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:155].

4717.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4721.r: The article turns the infinitive σπανίζειν into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

4722.r: γῆς σπανίζειν ἀγαθῆς “have so little fertile land”: σπανίζω takes the genitive of the thing lacked [SMYTH:1396].

4723.r: διὰ τὸ … σπανίζειν “because you have so little”: the articular infinitive after διά [SMYTH:2034]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4724.r: Agrees with γῆς and takes its case function [MORPH].

4727.r: νομίζετε “do you think”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4728.r: πένητες νομίζετʼ εἶναι “think you are poor”: the declarative infinitive; the predicate is nominative as referring to the subject [SMYTH:2018] [SMYTH:1973]. Active voice [MORPH].

4730.r: συνέφασαν “they agreed”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4734.r: τί οὖν “well then”: the interrogative as subject, ἐστί understood [SMYTH:938].

4738.r: ἔφη “said”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4739.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

4742.r: βούλοισθʼ ἄν “would you avail yourselves”: the potential optative with ἄν [CONV:D6]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. βούλομαι “wish” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

4744.r: ἀποτελοῦντες “on condition that you paid in full”: a conditional circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2067]. Agrees with the subject of βούλοισθ’ [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4745.n: TREE: ὅσαπερ is the object of ἀποτελοῦντες, not adverbial to ἐξεῖναι.
4745.r: ἀποτελοῦντες ὅσαπερ “paying just as much as”: the object of ἀποτελοῦντες [SMYTH:1553].

4746.r: Particular article: ἄλλοι is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

4747.r: Agrees with Ἀρμένιοι and takes its case function [MORPH].

4748.n: TREE: Ἀρμένιοι is the subject of the understood verb, not a predicate of ἐξεῖναι.
4748.r: ὅσαπερ οἱ ἄλλοι Ἀρμένιοι “as much as the other Armenians”: the subject of ἀποτελοῦσι understood [SMYTH:938].

4749.n: TREE: ἐξεῖναι depends on βούλοισθε, not on ἀποτελοῦντες.
4749.r: βούλοισθʼ ἂν … ἐξεῖναι “would you wish to be permitted”: βούλομαι with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:1991]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4750.r: ἐξεῖναι ὑμῖν “you to be permitted”: the dative with ἔξεστι [CONV:R18].

4751.r: Particular article: γῆς is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

4752.r: τῆς Ἀρμενίας γῆς “Armenian land”: used as an adjective with γῆς [SMYTH:1020].

4753.n: TREE: γῆς depends on ὁπόσην, not on ἐργάζεσθαι. ~~ γῆς is bracketed in the text
4753.r: τῆς Ἀρμενίας γῆς … ὁπόσην “as much Armenian land”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

4754.r: ἐργάζεσθαι “to till”: ἐργάζομαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]; the infinitive as subject of ἐξεῖναι [SMYTH:1985]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

4757.r: ὁπόσην ἂν θέλητε “as much as you wish”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a relative clause [SMYTH:2565]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4759.n: TREE: the postag should be v3piia--- (tree: v3paia---). TREE: ἔφασαν is the imperfect; the tree tags it aorist.
4759.r: ἔφασαν “said”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4760.r: The article makes Χαλδαῖοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

4764.r: εἰ πιστεύοιμεν “if we could be sure”: the optative of implied indirect discourse after a past tense [SMYTH:2619]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4766.r: πιστεύοιμεν μὴ ἀδικήσεσθαι “sure of not being molested”: the future middle infinitive in passive sense [SMYTH:1911]; the declarative infinitive [CONV:D7].

4768.r: τί δέ “tell me”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

4771.r: σύ, ὦ Ἀρμένιε “you, king of Armenia”: the subject of βούλοιο, with the vocative [SMYTH:1013].

4773.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4778.r: βούλοιο ἄν “would you be willing”: the potential optative with ἄν [CONV:D6]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. βούλομαι “wish” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

4780.n: TREE: σοι goes with γενέσθαι, not with βούλοιο.
4780.r: σοι … γενέσθαι “should be cultivated for you”: the dative of interest [SMYTH:1481].

4781.r: Particular article: γῆν is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

4783.r: τὴν νῦν ἀργὸν οὖσαν γῆν “the land which now lies uncultivated”: the predicate of the participle, in the accusative [CONV:R5].

4784.r: τὴν … οὖσαν γῆν “the land which is”: the attributive participle [SMYTH:2049]. Agrees with γῆν and takes its case function [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4786.r: ἐνεργὸν γενέσθαι “should be cultivated”: the predicate of the infinitive, in the accusative [CONV:R5].

4787.r: βούλοιο … γενέσθαι “be willing that should be”: βούλομαι with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:1991]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].

4790.r: εἰ μέλλοιεν “if they would”: the optative in the protasis of a less vivid condition [SMYTH:2329]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4791.r: The article makes νομιζόμενα a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

4792.r: Direct object of ἀποτελεῖν [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Passive: the subject is acted on [SMYTH:1735]. Attributive or substantival participle [SMYTH:2049].

4794.r: παρὰ σοί “in your country”: παρά with the dative of place [PREP:παρά] [CONV:D1].

4795.r: μέλλοιεν … ἀποτελεῖν “would pay”: μέλλω with the infinitive [SMYTH:1959]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

4796.r: The article makes ἐργαζόμενοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

4797.r: οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι “those who cultivate”: ἐργάζομαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]. Subject of μέλλοιεν [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Attributive or substantival participle [SMYTH:2049].

4799.r: ἔφη “answered”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4800.r: The article makes Ἀρμένιος a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

4802.r: πολλοῦ ἂν τοῦτο πρίασθαι “would give a great deal for it”: the genitive of price [SMYTH:1372] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:184].

4805.n: TREE: the postag should be v--anm--- (tree: v--pnm---). TREE: πρίασθαι is the aorist infinitive; the tree tags it present.
4805.r: ἔφη … ἂν … πρίασθαι “said he would give”: the infinitive with ἄν stands for a potential optative [CONV:R53] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:184]. πρίαμαι “buy” is middle-only, an indirect reflexive middle [CONV:D3].

4810.r: ἂν αὐξάνεσθαι “would be increased”: the infinitive with ἄν stands for a potential optative [CONV:R53] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:184]; passive [SMYTH:1735].

4811.r: Article with the abstract noun πρόσοδον [SMYTH:1131].

4812.n: TREE: πρόσοδον is the subject of αὐξάνεσθαι, not its object.
4812.r: αὐξάνεσθαι τὴν πρόσοδον “his revenues would be increased”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972].

4815.r: τί δʼ “and tell me”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

4818.r: ὑμεῖς … ὦ Χαλδαῖοι “you, Chaldaeans”: the subject of ἐθέλοιτε, with the vocative [SMYTH:1013].

4820.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4823.n: TREE: the postag should be a-p---mv- (tree: a-p---mn-). TREE: Χαλδαῖοι after ὦ is vocative, not nominative.
4823.r: ὦ Χαλδαῖοι “Chaldaeans”: the vocative after ὦ [CONV:R117].

4827.r: Agrees with ὄρη and takes its case function [MORPH].

4828.r: ἐπεὶ … ἔχετε “seeing that you have”: the present in a causal clause [SMYTH:2240]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

4830.r: ἐθέλοιτʼ ἄν “would you be willing”: the potential optative with ἄν [CONV:D6]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6062.r: ἔλαβεν “he had received”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6064.r: ἔλεξεν “spoke”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6068.r: The article makes μέσον a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6075.r: καὶ πάντων “and all”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

6077.n: TREE: the relative clause depends on πάντων, not on μέσον.
6077.r: ὅσους ἐτίμα “whom he was about to reward”: the imperfect of an action about to be done [SMYTH:1895]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6082.r: δοκεῖ “seems”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6083.r: δοκεῖ ἡμῖν “seems to us”: the dative with δοκεῖ [CONV:R18].

6085.r: εὐφροσύνη τις “a kind of gladness”: τις agrees with εὐφροσύνη [SMYTH:1020].

6087.r: δοκεῖ … παρεῖναι “seems to be present”: δοκέω “seem” with the infinitive [CONV:R7]. Active voice [MORPH].

6092.r: εὐπορία τις “some degree of prosperity”: τις agrees with εὐπορία [SMYTH:1020].

6096.r: ἔχομεν ἀφʼ ὧν “we have the means”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6098.r: ἀφʼ ὧν “whereby”: ἀπό with the genitive of means [PREP:ἀπό] [SMYTH:2513].

6100.r: ἕξομεν “we shall be able”: the future [SMYTH:1910]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6103.n: TREE: the relative clause depends on τιμᾶν, not on ἕξομεν.

6105.r: καὶ τιμᾶσθαι “and of receiving rewards”: the passive infinitive [SMYTH:1735]; ἔχω “be able” with the infinitive [SMYTH:2000]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

6110.r: ὡς ἂν ἕκαστος ἄξιος ᾖ “each according to his deserts”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a clause of manner [SMYTH:2565]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6114.r: ἀναμιμνῃσκώμεθα “let us remember”: the hortatory subjunctive [SMYTH:1797]; ἀναμιμνῄσκομαι, a mental middle [CONV:D3]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

6115.r: Article with the abstract noun ἔργα [SMYTH:1131].

6116.n: TREE: the postag should be a-p---nn- (tree: a-p---na-). TREE: ποῖα is nominative, agreeing with ἔργα.

6117.r: Agrees with ἔργα and takes its case function [MORPH].

6119.r: Agrees with ἀγαθῶν and takes its case function [MORPH].

6122.r: ἐστιν “are”: the present, in an indirect question [SMYTH:2677]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. σκοπέω in the middle, “consider”: a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

6127.r: εὑρήσετε “you will find”: the future [SMYTH:1910]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6132.r: ὅπου ἔδει “when occasion demanded”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6134.r: The article turns the infinitive πονῆσαι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

6135.r: καὶ τὸ πονῆσαι “undergoing toil”: the articular infinitive as object [SMYTH:2034]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6137.r: The article turns the infinitive σπεῦσαι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

6138.r: καὶ τὸ σπεῦσαι “making due haste”: the articular infinitive as object [SMYTH:2034]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6140.r: The article turns the infinitive εἶξαι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

6142.r: καὶ τὸ μὴ εἶξαι “and never yielding”: the articular infinitive as object [SMYTH:2034]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6143.r: The article makes πολεμίοις a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6144.r: εἶξαι τοῖς πολεμίοις “yielding to the enemy”: εἴκω takes the dative [SMYTH:1460].

6148.r: χρή “we must”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6150.r: The article makes λοιπὸν a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6151.r: καὶ τὸ λοιπόν “in future also”: the accusative of time [SMYTH:1611].

6152.r: ἄνδρας ἀγαθοὺς εἶναι “be brave men”: the predicate of the infinitive, in the accusative, ἡμᾶς understood [CONV:R5].

6153.r: Predicate in the accusative, agreeing with the accusative subject of εἶναι [SMYTH:1062]; the predicate accusative is tagged AccDoubl [CONV:R5].

6154.r: χρὴ … εἶναι “we must be”: the infinitive with χρή [SMYTH:1985]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6156.r: γιγνώσκοντας “knowing”: the accusative participle agrees with the unexpressed subject of the infinitive [CONV:R92]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6158.r: Article with the abstract noun ἡδονὰς [SMYTH:1131].

6159.r: Agrees with ἡδονὰς and takes its case function [MORPH].

6162.r: The article makes τἀγαθὰ a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6164.r: The article makes τἀγαθὰ a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6165.r: Agrees with τἀγαθὰ and takes its case function [MORPH].

6166.r: Article with the abstract noun πειθὼ [SMYTH:1131].

6169.r: Article with the abstract noun καρτερία [SMYTH:1131].

6172.r: Article with the abstract noun πόνοι [SMYTH:1131].

6174.r: Particular article: καιρῷ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6175.r: οἱ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ πόνοι “toil at the critical time”: ἐν with the dative of time [PREP:ἐν] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:191] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:162].

6179.r: παρέχονται “bring”: the present of a general truth [CONV:R12]; the indirect middle “procure” [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6181.r: κατανοῶν “Cyrus now saw”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of ἐπεθύμει [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6183.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

6189.r: ὡς εὖ … εἶχον “that were in good condition”: the imperfect, kept in indirect discourse [SMYTH:2579]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6190.r: Particular article: σώματα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6191.n: TREE: σώματα is an accusative of respect, not an object.
6191.r: εὖ … εἶχον τὰ σώματα “were in good physical condition”: the accusative of respect [SMYTH:1601] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:191].

6192.r: Particular article: στρατιῶται is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6195.r: The article turns the infinitive δύνασθαι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

6196.r: πρὸς τὸ δύνασθαι “to be able”: the articular infinitive after πρός [SMYTH:2034]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. δύναμαι “be able” is middle-only and fits none of the middle types well; the case is still open [CONV:D3] [CONV:R3].

6197.r: Agrees with πόνους and takes its case function [MORPH].

6199.r: δύνασθαι … φέρειν “able to endure”: δύναμαι with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:2000]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6203.r: Article with the abstract noun ψυχὰς [SMYTH:1131].

6204.n: TREE: ψυχάς is an accusative of respect with εἶχον, not an object of φέρειν.
6204.r: εὖ δὲ τὰς ψυχάς “and their hearts were disposed”: the accusative of respect, εἶχον understood [SMYTH:1601].

6206.r: The article turns the infinitive καταφρονεῖν into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

6207.r: πρὸς τὸ καταφρονεῖν “to regard with contempt”: the articular infinitive after πρός [SMYTH:2034]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6208.r: The article makes πολεμίων a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6209.r: καταφρονεῖν τῶν πολεμίων “regard the enemy with contempt”: καταφρονέω takes the genitive [SMYTH:1385].

6213.r: ἐπιστήμονες δʼ ἦσαν “they were skilled”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6214.r: The article makes προσήκοντα a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6215.n: TREE: προσήκοντα depends on ἐπιστήμονες, not the subject of ἦσαν.
6215.r: ἐπιστήμονες … τὰ προσήκοντα “skilled in the exercise adapted”: the accusative with an adjective of knowledge; the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:1601] [SMYTH:2050]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6216.r: Article with the abstract noun ὁπλίσει [SMYTH:1131].

6217.r: τῇ ἑαυτῶν … ὁπλίσει “their own kind of armour”: the reflexive possessive genitive [SMYTH:1200].

6219.r: τὰ προσήκοντα τῇ … ὁπλίσει “adapted to his kind of armour”: the dative with προσήκω [SMYTH:1463].

6223.r: The article turns the infinitive πείθεσθαι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

6224.r: πρὸς τὸ πείθεσθαι “to obey”: the articular infinitive after πρός [SMYTH:2034]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. πείθομαι “obey, trust”: a middle of mental process; it can also be read as passive “be persuaded” [CONV:D3].

6226.r: The article makes ἄρχουσιν a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6227.r: πείθεσθαι … τοῖς ἄρχουσιν “obey the officers”: πείθομαι takes the dative; the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:1464] [SMYTH:2050]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6228.r: ἑώρα “he saw”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6229.n: TREE: πάντας is the object of ἑώρα, not attributive.
6229.r: ἑώρα πάντας … παρεσκευασμένους “saw that they were all well disciplined”: the object of a verb of perception with a supplementary participle [CONV:R4].

6231.r: ἑώρα … εὖ παρεσκευασμένους “saw well disciplined”: the supplementary participle with a verb of perception [CONV:R4]; the perfect passive [SMYTH:1735]. In indirect discourse the tense is that of the direct form [CONV:D7].

6234.r: ἐκ τούτων “accordingly”: ἐκ with the genitive, of the ground or consequence [PREP:ἐκ] [CONV:R31].

6236.r: ἐπεθύμει “he was eager”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6241.r: The article makes πολεμίους a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6242.r: πρὸς τοὺς πολεμίους “against the enemy”: πρός with the accusative of an opponent [CONV:R41].

6243.n: TREE: πράττειν is not an articular infinitive.
6243.r: ἐπεθύμει … πράττειν “was eager to undertake”: the dynamic infinitive after a verb of desire [SMYTH:1991]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6245.r: γιγνώσκων “for he knew”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of ἐπεθύμει [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6248.r: The article turns the infinitive μέλλειν into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

6249.r: ἐν τῷ μέλλειν “through delay”: the articular infinitive after ἐν [SMYTH:2034]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6251.r: The article makes ἄρχουσι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6252.n: TREE: ἄρχουσι depends on ἀλλοιοῦται, not on μέλλειν.
6252.r: τοῖς ἄρχουσι “for generals”: the dative of interest; the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:1481] [SMYTH:2050]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6254.r: Article with the abstract noun παρασκευῆς [SMYTH:1131].

6255.r: Agrees with παρασκευῆς and takes its case function [MORPH].

6256.n: TREE: παρασκευῆς depends on τι, not on μέλλειν.
6256.r: καὶ τῆς καλῆς παρασκευῆς … τι “some even of their best laid plans”: the partitive genitive with τι [SMYTH:1306] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:162].

6257.r: ἀλλοιοῦται “is brought to naught”: the present of a general truth [CONV:R12]; passive [SMYTH:1735]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6262.r: ἔτι δʼ ὁρῶν “and he further observed”: a causal circumstantial participle, taken up by τούτων ἕνεκα [SMYTH:2064] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:191]. Agrees with the subject of ἐβούλετο [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6265.r: φιλοτίμως ἔχοντες “because they were so eager to excel”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of εἶχον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6267.r: ἐν οἷς ἀντηγωνίζοντο “in those exercises in which they vied”: ἐν with the relative, = ἐν τούτοις ἅ [PREP:ἐν] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:191].

6268.r: ἀντηγωνίζοντο “they vied with one another”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. ἀνταγωνίζομαι “contend against” is middle-only, a verb of contending [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6269.n: TREE: πολλοί is the subject of εἶχον, not of ἀντηγωνίζοντο.
6269.r: πολλοὶ … εἶχον … τῶν στρατιωτῶν “many of the soldiers were”: the subject of εἶχον [SMYTH:938].

6272.r: ἐπιφθόνως εἶχον “were jealous”: the imperfect, kept in indirect discourse [SMYTH:2579]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6274.r: πρὸς ἀλλήλους “of one another”: πρός with the accusative of the persons one acts towards [CONV:R41].

6275.r: Particular article: στρατιωτῶν is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6276.n: TREE: στρατιωτῶν depends on πολλοί, not on εἶχον.
6276.r: πολλοὶ … τῶν στρατιωτῶν “many of the soldiers”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

6279.n: TREE: τούτων ἕνεκα goes with ἐβούλετο.
6279.r: καὶ τούτων ἕνεκα “for this reason also”: ἕνεκα with the genitive [CONV:R10] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:191].

6281.r: ἐξάγειν … ἐβούλετο “wished to lead”: βούλομαι with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:1991]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6282.n: TREE: αὐτούς is the object of ἐξάγειν, not its subject.

6283.r: ἐβούλετο “he wished”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. βούλομαι “wish” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6285.r: The article makes πολεμίαν a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6286.r: εἰς τὴν πολεμίαν “into the enemy’s country”: εἰς with the accusative of direction, γῆν omitted [PREP:εἰς] [CONV:D1].

6288.r: ὡς τάχιστα “as soon as possible”: the superlative adverb with ὡς [SMYTH:1086].

6290.r: εἰδώς “for he knew”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of ἐβούλετο [MORPH]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6292.r: Article with the abstract noun κίνδυνοι [SMYTH:1131].

6293.r: Agrees with κίνδυνοι and takes its case function [MORPH].

6296.r: ποιοῦσιν “make”: the present of a general truth [CONV:R12]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6297.r: ποιοῦσιν ἔχειν “make be disposed”: ποιέω “cause” with the infinitive [SMYTH:1992]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6298.r: The article makes συμμάχους a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6299.n: TREE: συμμάχους is the subject of ἔχειν, not its object.
6299.r: ποιοῦσιν ἔχειν τοὺς συμμάχους “make comrades kindly disposed”: the person caused to act, subject of ἔχειν [SMYTH:1972].

6301.r: πρὸς ἀλλήλους “toward one another”: πρός with the accusative of the persons one acts towards [CONV:R41].

6306.r: ἐν τούτῳ “in the midst of such dangers”: ἐν with the dative of circumstance [PREP:ἐν] [CONV:D1].

6309.r: The article makes κοσμουμένοις a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6312.n: TREE: κοσμουμένοις depends on φθονοῦσιν, not on τούτῳ.

6313.r: φθονοῦσιν “are jealous”: the present of a general truth [CONV:R12]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6316.r: Article with the abstract noun δόξης [SMYTH:1131].

6317.r: δόξης ἐφιεμένοις “striving for glory”: ἐφίεμαι takes the genitive [SMYTH:1349].

6318.n: TREE: ἐφιεμένοις depends on φθονοῦσιν, not on τούτῳ.
6318.r: τοῖς δόξης ἐφιεμένοις “those who strive for glory”: the dative with φθονοῦσιν; the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:1461] [SMYTH:2050]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

6323.r: ἐπαινοῦσι “they praise”: the present of a general truth [CONV:R12]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6326.r: Particular article: τοιοῦτοι is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6327.n: TREE: τοιοῦτοι is the subject of ἀσπάζονται.
6327.r: οἱ τοιοῦτοι “soldiers”: the subject of ἐπαινοῦσι and ἀσπάζονται [SMYTH:938] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:192].

6328.r: The article makes ὁμοίους a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6329.r: τοὺς ὁμοίους “their fellows”: the object of ἐπαινοῦσι and ἀσπάζονται [SMYTH:1553] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:192].

6331.r: νομίζοντες “because they recognize”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of ἀσπάζονται [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].
