6952.r: ἵλεως … ὄντας “being gracious”: a circumstantial participle agreeing with οὕς [SMYTH:2060]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

6953.r: ἡγεμόνας ἂν γενέσθαι “would be leaders”: the predicate of the infinitive, in the accusative [CONV:R5].

6955.n: ἄν is bracketed in the text
6955.r: ἡγεῖτο … ἂν γενέσθαι “thought would be”: the infinitive with ἄν stands for a potential optative [CONV:R53]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].

6956.r: Particular article: στρατιᾷ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6957.r: ἡγεμόνας … τῇ στρατιᾷ “leaders for his army”: the dative of interest [SMYTH:1481].

6959.r: καὶ παραστάτας ἀγαθούς “and mighty defenders”: the predicate of the infinitive, in the accusative [CONV:R5].

6960.r: Agrees with παραστάτας and takes its case function [MORPH].

6962.r: καὶ συμμάχους “and helpers”: the predicate of the infinitive, in the accusative [CONV:R5].

6964.r: καὶ συμβούλους “and counsellors”: the predicate of the infinitive, in the accusative [CONV:R5].

6965.r: The article makes ἀγαθῶν a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

6966.r: συμβούλους τῶν ἀγαθῶν “counsellors for the common good”: the objective genitive [SMYTH:1331].

6969.r: συμπαρεκάλει “he called also upon”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6973.n: TREE: γῆς depends on οἰκήτορας, not on ἥρωας.
6973.r: γῆς Μηδίας οἰκήτορας “who dwelt in Media”: the objective genitive with an agent noun [SMYTH:1331] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:196].

6974.r: γῆς Μηδίας “the land of Media”: the appositional genitive [SMYTH:1322].

6975.n: TREE: οἰκήτορας is in apposition to ἥρωας.
6975.r: ἥρωας … οἰκήτορας καὶ κηδεμόνας “heroes who dwelt in Media and were its guardians”: in apposition to ἥρωας [SMYTH:976].

6977.n: TREE: κηδεμόνας is in apposition to ἥρωας.
6977.r: καὶ κηδεμόνας “and guardians”: in apposition to ἥρωας [SMYTH:976].

6981.r: ἐπεὶ δʼ ἐκαλλιέρησε “when the sacrifice was found to be favourable”: the aorist in a temporal clause [SMYTH:2383]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6985.r: ἁθρόον ἦν “was assembled”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

6986.r: ἦν αὐτῷ τὸ στράτευμα “his army was”: the dative of interest [SMYTH:1481]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

6987.r: Particular article: στράτευμα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6990.r: Particular article: ὁρίοις is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

6991.r: πρὸς τοῖς ὁρίοις “at the frontier”: πρός with the dative of place [PREP:πρός] [CONV:D1].

6995.r: οἰωνοῖς χρησάμενος “amid auspices”: χράομαι takes the dative [SMYTH:1509].

6996.n: TREE: the lemma should be χράομαι.
6996.r: χρησάμενος “having”: a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of ἐνέβαλεν [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. χράομαι “use” is middle-only: the subject avails itself of something, an indirect reflexive middle [CONV:D3].

6997.r: Agrees with οἰωνοῖς and takes its case function [MORPH].

6998.r: ἐνέβαλεν “he crossed into”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7000.r: The article makes πολεμίαν a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7001.r: εἰς τὴν πολεμίαν “into the enemy’s country”: εἰς with the accusative of direction [PREP:εἰς] [CONV:D1].

7005.r: ἐπεὶ δὲ τάχιστα “as soon as”: the superlative adverb with ἐπεί [SMYTH:1086].

7006.r: διέβη “he had crossed”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7007.r: Particular article: ὅρια is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7014.r: ἱλάσκετο “he made propitiatory offerings”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]; ἱλάσκομαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7015.r: χοαῖς “with libations”: the dative of means [SMYTH:1507].

7017.n: TREE: θεούς is the object of ἱλάσκετο, not of ηὐμενίζετο.
7017.r: καὶ θεοὺς θυσίαις “and the gods with sacrifices”: the object of ἱλάσκετο [SMYTH:1553].

7018.r: θυσίαις “with sacrifices”: the dative of means [SMYTH:1507].

7020.n: TREE: ἥρωας is the object of ηὐμενίζετο.
7020.r: ἥρωας … ηὐμενίζετο “sought to win the favour of the heroes”: the object of ηὐμενίζετο [SMYTH:1553].

7021.r: Ἀσσυρίας οἰκήτορας “that dwelt in Assyria”: the objective genitive with an agent noun [SMYTH:1331].

7022.n: TREE: οἰκήτορας is in apposition to ἥρωας.
7022.r: ἥρωας … οἰκήτορας “heroes that dwelt”: in apposition to ἥρωας [SMYTH:976].

7023.r: ηὐμενίζετο “sought to win the favour of”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]; εὐμενίζομαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7027.r: ταῦτα δὲ ποιήσας “when he had done this”: a temporal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of ἔθυε [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7029.r: Διὶ πατρῴῳ ἔθυε “sacrificed to Zeus, the god of his fathers”: the dative of the god to whom one sacrifices [SMYTH:1469].

7030.r: Agrees with Διὶ and takes its case function [MORPH].

7031.r: ἔθυε “he sacrificed”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7037.r: τις ἄλλος θεῶν “any other of the divinities”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

7038.r: εἴ … ἀνεφαίνετο “that were brought to his attention”: the imperfect in a past general condition [SMYTH:2340]; ἀναφαίνομαι “appear” [SMYTH:1735]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7040.r: οὐδενὸς ἠμέλει “neglected not one”: ἀμελέω takes the genitive [SMYTH:1356].

7041.r: ἠμέλει “he neglected”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7047.r: ἐπεὶ δὲ καλῶς ταῦτα εἶχεν “when these rites were duly performed”: the imperfect of ἔχω with an adverb [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7050.r: The article makes πεζοὺς a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7053.r: προαγαγόντες “they led forward and”: a temporal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of ἐστρατοπεδεύοντο [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7055.r: Agrees with ὁδὸν and takes its case function [MORPH].

7056.n: TREE: ὁδόν is the extent of προαγαγόντες, not the object of ἐστρατοπεδεύοντο.
7056.r: οὐ πολλὴν ὁδόν “a short distance”: the accusative of extent of space [SMYTH:1581].

7057.r: ἐστρατοπεδεύοντο “pitched camp”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. στρατοπεδεύομαι “encamp”: the subject pitches its own camp [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7059.r: Particular article: ἵπποις is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7061.n: TREE: ἵπποις is instrumental, not an object of ποιησάμενοι.
7061.r: τοῖς δʼ ἵπποις “with the cavalry”: the dative of means [SMYTH:1507].

7063.r: καταδρομὴν ποιησάμενοι “they made a raid and”: a temporal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of περιεβάλοντο [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Middle of ποιέω: the subject makes or does something for itself or with its own means [SMYTH:1719].

7064.r: περιεβάλοντο “got possession of”: the indirect middle, “gather round oneself” [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7065.r: Agrees with λείαν and takes its case function [MORPH].

7067.r: Agrees with λείαν and takes its case function [MORPH].

7071.r: The article makes λοιπὸν a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7072.r: καὶ τὸ λοιπὸν δέ “and thenceforward”: the accusative of time [SMYTH:1611] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:247].

7074.r: μεταστρατοπεδευόμενοι “shifting their camp”: μεταστρατοπεδεύομαι [CONV:D3]; a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of ἀνέμενον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

7076.r: ἔχοντες “keeping”: a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of ἀνέμενον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7077.n: TREE: ἄφθονα is a predicate with ἔχοντες, not attributive.
7077.r: ἔχοντες ἄφθονα τὰ ἐπιτήδεια “kept provisions supplied in abundance”: the predicate accusative [CONV:R5].

7078.r: The article makes ἐπιτήδεια a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7081.r: δῃοῦντες τὴν χώραν “ravaging the country”: a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of ἀνέμενον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7082.r: Particular article: χώραν is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7084.r: ἀνέμενον “they awaited”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7085.r: The article makes πολεμίους a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7090.r: προσιόντες ἐλέγοντο “were said to be advancing”: a circumstantial participle with the personal construction [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of ἐλέγοντο [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7091.r: ἐλέγοντο “rumours came”: the imperfect passive in the personal construction [SMYTH:1982]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7094.r: δέχʼ ἡμερῶν ὁδόν “ten days’ march”: the genitive of measure [SMYTH:1325].

7095.r: ὁδὸν ἀπέχειν “to be a march away”: the accusative of extent of space [SMYTH:1581].

7096.r: ἐλέγοντο … ἀπέχειν “were said to be away”: the infinitive with the personal passive of λέγω [SMYTH:1982]. Active voice [MORPH].

7100.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

7102.r: λέγει “said”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7107.r: ὥρα δὴ ἀπαντᾶν “now is the time to go to meet”: ὥρα with the infinitive as subject, ἐστί understood [SMYTH:1985].

7109.r: ὥρα … ἀπαντᾶν “time to go to meet”: the infinitive with ὥρα (ἐστί) [SMYTH:1985]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7113.r: The article makes πολεμίοις a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7114.r: μήτε τοῖς πολεμίοις δοκεῖν “not to let either the enemy suppose”: the dative with δοκεῖν [CONV:R18].

7115.r: ὥρα … μήτε … δοκεῖν “time not to seem”: the infinitive with ὥρα (ἐστί) [SMYTH:1985]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7118.r: The article makes ἡμετέροις a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7119.n: TREE: ἡμετέροις depends on δοκεῖν, not on φοβουμένους.
7119.r: μήτε τοῖς ἡμετέροις “nor our own men”: the dative with δοκεῖν [CONV:R18].

7120.r: φοβουμένους μὴ ἀντιπροσιέναι “that we fail to advance out of fear”: the accusative participle agrees with the unexpressed subject of the infinitive [CONV:R92] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:197]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. φοβέομαι “fear” is a middle of emotion (mental process) [CONV:D3].

7122.n: TREE: ἀντιπροσιέναι depends on δοκεῖν, not on ὥρα.
7122.r: δοκεῖν … μὴ ἀντιπροσιέναι “seem not to advance against them”: δοκέω “seem” with the infinitive [CONV:R7]. Active voice [MORPH].

7126.r: ἀλλὰ δῆλοι ὦμεν “but let us make it clear”: the hortatory subjunctive [SMYTH:1797] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:197]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7129.r: οὐκ ἄκοντες “not against our will”: the adjective in predicate agreement with the subject [SMYTH:1043] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:197].

7130.r: μαχούμεθα “we are going to fight”: the future [SMYTH:1910]. μάχομαι “fight” is middle-only, a reciprocal middle of contending [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7136.r: ἐπεὶ … συνέδοξε “as Cyaxares agreed”: the aorist in a temporal clause [SMYTH:2383]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7137.r: Article with the proper name Κυαξάρῃ [SMYTH:1136].

7138.r: συνέδοξε τῷ Κυαξάρῃ “Cyaxares agreed”: the dative with δοκεῖ [CONV:R18].

7142.r: συντεταγμένοι “in battle order”: a circumstantial participle of manner [SMYTH:2062]; passive [SMYTH:1735]. Agrees with the subject of προῇσαν [MORPH]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859].

7143.r: προῇσαν “they advanced each day”: the imperfect of repeated action [SMYTH:1893]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7144.r: τοσοῦτον … ὅσον “as far as”: the accusative of extent [SMYTH:1581].

7146.r: καθʼ ἡμέραν “each day”: κατά with the accusative, distributive [CONV:R115].

7147.r: ὅσον ἐδόκει “as far as they thought”: the accusative of extent, correlative with τοσοῦτον [SMYTH:1581].

7148.r: ἐδόκει “seemed”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7149.n: TREE: αὐτοῖς depends on ἐδόκει, not on ἔχειν.
7149.r: ἐδόκει αὐτοῖς “they thought”: the dative with δοκεῖ [CONV:R18]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

7151.r: ἐδόκει … καλῶς ἔχειν “seemed proper”: δοκέω “seem” with the infinitive [CONV:R7]. Active voice [MORPH].

7158.r: κατὰ φῶς “by daylight”: κατά with the accusative of time [CONV:R115].

7159.r: δεῖπνον … ἐποιοῦντο “they always prepared their dinner”: the imperfect of customary action [SMYTH:1893]; the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7165.r: οὐκ ἔκαιον “they never lighted”: the imperfect of customary action [SMYTH:1893]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7167.r: Particular article: στρατοπέδῳ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7168.r: Dative with ἐν, “in, at”: place where [PREP:ἐν]; the tag gives the function of the phrase [CONV:D1].

7172.r: Particular article: στρατοπέδου is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7173.r: ἔμπροσθεν … τοῦ στρατοπέδου “in front of the camp”: ἔμπροσθεν with the genitive [CONV:R10].

7174.r: ἔκαιον “they kept fires burning”: the imperfect of customary action [SMYTH:1893]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7177.r: ὅπως ὁρῷεν “in order that they might see”: ὅπως with the optative of purpose after a past tense [SMYTH:2196]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7181.r: νυκτός “in the dark”: the genitive of time within which [SMYTH:1444].

7182.r: εἴ τινες … προσίοιεν “if any one approached”: the optative in an indirect question after a past tense [SMYTH:2677]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7184.r: Particular article: πῦρ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7185.n: TREE: διὰ τὸ πῦρ goes with ὁρῷεν.
7185.r: διὰ τὸ πῦρ “by the light of the fire”: διά with the accusative of cause [PREP:διά] [CONV:D1].

7188.r: μὴ ὁρῷντο “but not be seen”: ὅπως with the optative of purpose after a past tense [SMYTH:2196]; passive [SMYTH:1735]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

7191.r: The article makes προσιόντων a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7192.r: ὑπὸ τῶν προσιόντων “by those approaching”: ὑπό with the genitive of the agent [CONV:D4]; the participle used as a noun [SMYTH:2050]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7198.r: Particular article: στρατοπέδου is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7199.r: ὄπισθεν τοῦ στρατοπέδου “in the rear of the camp”: ὄπισθεν with the genitive [CONV:R10].

7200.r: ἐπυρπόλουν “they kept fires burning”: the imperfect of customary action [SMYTH:1893]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7201.r: ἀπάτης ἕνεκα “for the purpose of deceiving”: ἕνεκα with the genitive [CONV:R10].

7203.r: The article makes πολεμίων a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7204.n: TREE: πολεμίων depends on ἀπάτης, not on ἕνεκα.
7204.r: ἀπάτης … τῶν πολεμίων “deceiving the enemy”: the objective genitive [SMYTH:1331].

7207.r: ἔστιν ὅτε “sometimes”: the present in the idiom ἔστιν ὅτε [SMYTH:2515]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7211.r: ἐνέπιπτον “fell into the hands of”: the imperfect of repeated action [SMYTH:1893]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7213.r: Article with the abstract noun προφυλακὰς [SMYTH:1131].

7214.r: εἰς τὰς προφυλακάς “into the hands of the pickets”: εἰς with the accusative of direction [PREP:εἰς] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:167].

7215.r: τὰς προφυλακὰς αὐτῶν “their pickets”: the possessive genitive [SMYTH:1297]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

7218.r: The article turns the infinitive εἶναι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

7220.r: Particular article: πυρὰ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7222.n: TREE: the clause goes with οἰόμενοι, not with ἔστιν.
7222.r: διὰ τὸ ὄπισθεν τὰ πυρὰ εἶναι “because the fires were behind”: the articular infinitive after διά [SMYTH:2034] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:197] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:167]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7225.r: Particular article: στρατοπέδου is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7226.n: TREE: στρατοπέδου depends on πρόσω, not on πρόσω as in the tree.
7226.r: πρόσω τοῦ στρατοπέδου “far in front of the camp”: the genitive with an adverb of distance [SMYTH:1392].

7227.r: οἰόμενοι “for they supposed”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of ἐνέπιπτον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. οἴομαι “think” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

7228.r: οἰόμενοι … εἶναι “supposing themselves to be”: the declarative infinitive [SMYTH:2018]. Active voice [MORPH].

7230.r: The article makes Ἀσσύριοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7235.r: οἱ σὺν αὐτοῖς “their allies”: the article makes the prepositional phrase a noun [SMYTH:1153].

7237.r: Dative with σύν, “with”: accompaniment [PREP:σύν]; the tag gives the function of the phrase [CONV:D1]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

7242.r: ἐγγὺς ἀλλήλων “near each other”: ἐγγύς with the genitive [CONV:R10].

7243.r: Particular article: στρατεύματα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7245.r: ἐπεὶ … ἐγίγνοντο “when were near”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7248.r: τάφρον περιεβάλοντο “drew a ditch around their camp”: the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7254.n: TREE: the relative clause refers to the whole action of περιεβάλοντο, not to τάφρον.
7254.r: ὅπερ … ποιοῦσιν “as do”: the present of customary action [CONV:R12]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7255.r: The article makes βάρβαροι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7256.r: οἱ βάρβαροι βασιλεῖς “the barbarian kings”: βάρβαροι agrees with βασιλεῖς [SMYTH:1020] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:197].

7261.n: TREE: the clause depends on περιβάλλονται, not on βασιλεῖς.
7261.r: ὅπου ἂν στρατοπεδεύωνται “whenever they go into camp”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a general relative clause [SMYTH:2565]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. στρατοπεδεύομαι “encamp”: the subject pitches its own camp [SMYTH:1719].

7264.r: περιβάλλονται “they throw up”: the present of customary action [CONV:R12]; the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7267.r: Article with the abstract noun πολυχειρίαν [SMYTH:1131].

7268.r: διὰ τὴν πολυχειρίαν “because of the multitude of hands”: διά with the accusative of cause [PREP:διά] [CONV:D1].

7270.r: οἶδα is a perfect with present meaning [SMYTH:1946]; the plain tag is kept, with the intensive perfect as the alternative [CONV:R6]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7273.r: Agrees with στράτευμα and takes its case function [MORPH].

7276.r: Dative with ἐν, “in, during”: time when [PREP:ἐν]; the tag gives the function of the phrase [CONV:D1].

7278.r: ὅτι … ἐστι “that are”: the present, kept in indirect discourse [SMYTH:2579]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7284.n: TREE: βάρβαρον agrees with στράτευμα; it is not a subject.
7284.r: ἄλλως τε καὶ βάρβαρον “especially barbarian”: agrees with στράτευμα [SMYTH:1020].

7286.n: TREE: πεποδισμένους is a predicate with ἔχουσι, not attributive.
7286.r: πεποδισμένους … ἔχουσι τοὺς ἵππους “keep their horses hobbled”: the predicate participle with ἔχω [CONV:R39]; passive [SMYTH:1735]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859].

7288.r: ἔχουσι “they keep”: the present of customary action [CONV:R12]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7289.r: Particular article: ἵππους is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7292.r: Particular article: φάτναις is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7293.r: ἐπὶ ταῖς φάτναις “at the mangers”: ἐπί with the dative of place [PREP:ἐπί] [CONV:D1].

7299.r: ἐπʼ αὐτούς “against them”: ἐπί with the accusative of direction, against an enemy [PREP:ἐπί] [CONV:D1]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

7300.r: εἴ τις … ἴοι “if any enemy should make an attack”: the optative in the protasis of a less vivid condition [SMYTH:2329]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7302.n: TREE: the postag should be n-s---nn- (tree: n-s---na-). TREE: ἔργον is a nominative predicate, not the object of λῦσαι.
7302.r: ἔργον μὲν … λῦσαι “it is a difficult task to loose”: the predicate, ἐστί understood, with the infinitive as subject [SMYTH:1985].

7304.r: νυκτός “in the darkness”: the genitive of time within which [SMYTH:1444].

7305.n: TREE: λῦσαι depends on ἔργον (ἐστί), not on ἔχουσι.
7305.r: ἔργον … λῦσαι ἵππους “difficult to loose the horses”: the infinitive as subject [SMYTH:1985]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7308.n: TREE: the postag should be n-s---nn- (tree: n-s---na-). TREE: ἔργον is a nominative predicate.
7308.r: ἔργον δὲ χαλινῶσαι “difficult to bridle them”: the predicate, ἐστί understood [SMYTH:1985].

7310.r: χαλινῶσαι “to bridle”: the infinitive as subject [SMYTH:1985]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7312.n: TREE: the postag should be n-s---nn- (tree: n-s---na-). TREE: ἔργον is a nominative predicate.
7312.r: ἔργον δʼ ἐπισάξαι “difficult to saddle them”: the predicate, ἐστί understood [SMYTH:1985].

7314.r: ἐπισάξαι “to saddle”: the infinitive as subject [SMYTH:1985]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7316.n: TREE: the postag should be n-s---nn- (tree: n-s---na-). TREE: ἔργον is a nominative predicate.
7316.r: ἔργον δὲ θωρακίσασθαι “difficult to put on a coat of mail”: the predicate, ἐστί understood [SMYTH:1985].

7318.r: θωρακίσασθαι “to put on a coat of mail”: the direct middle, “arm oneself” [SMYTH:1717]; the infinitive as subject [SMYTH:1985]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859].

7320.r: ἀναβάντας “to mount and”: the accusative participle agrees with the unexpressed subject of the infinitive [CONV:R92]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7323.r: ἐφʼ ἵππων “on horses”: ἐπί with the genitive of place [PREP:ἐπί] [CONV:D1].

7324.n: TREE: ἐλάσαι depends on ἀδύνατον (ἐστί), not on ἔχουσι.
7324.r: ἐλάσαι … ἀδύνατον “impossible to ride”: the infinitive as subject [SMYTH:1985]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7326.r: διὰ στρατοπέδου “through camp”: διά with the genitive of place through which [PREP:διά] [CONV:D1].

7328.r: Predicate nominative with the verb understood [SMYTH:910].

7331.r: τούτων δὴ ἕνεκα πάντων “for all these reasons”: ἕνεκα with the genitive [CONV:R10].

7334.r: τούτων … πάντων “all these”: πάντων agrees with τούτων [SMYTH:1020].

7336.r: Particular article: ἄλλοι is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7340.r: Particular article: ἐρύματα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7342.r: περιβάλλονται “throw up”: the present of customary action [CONV:R12]; the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7346.n: TREE: αὐτοῖς is not governed by ἅμα; it depends on δοκεῖ.
7346.r: ἅμα αὐτοῖς δοκεῖ “also because they think”: the dative with δοκεῖ; ἅμα is an adverb here [CONV:R18]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

7347.r: δοκεῖ “they think”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7348.r: The article turns the infinitive εἶναι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

7350.n: TREE: the postag should be a-s---nd- (tree: a-s---md-). TREE: ἐχυρῷ is neuter, a strong place.
7350.r: ἐν ἐχυρῷ “behind fortifications”: ἐν with the dative of place [PREP:ἐν] [CONV:D1].

7351.r: τὸ ἐν ἐχυρῷ εἶναι “being behind fortifications”: the articular infinitive as subject [SMYTH:2031]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7353.r: δοκεῖ … ἐξουσίαν παρέχειν “seems to give them the power”: δοκέω “seem” with the infinitive [CONV:R7]. Active voice [MORPH].

7355.r: ὅταν βούλωνται “when they wish”: ὅταν with the subjunctive [SMYTH:2401]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. βούλομαι “wish” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

7356.r: βούλωνται μάχεσθαι “wish to fight”: βούλομαι with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:1991]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. μάχομαι “fight” is middle-only, a reciprocal middle of contending [CONV:D3].

7361.r: τοιαῦτα μὲν δὴ ποιοῦντες “with such tactics”: a circumstantial participle of manner [SMYTH:2062]. Agrees with the subject of ἐγίγνοντο [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7363.r: ἐγγὺς ἀλλήλων “near each other”: ἐγγύς with the genitive [CONV:R10].

7364.r: ἐγίγνοντο “were approaching”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7368.r: προσιόντες “as they advanced”: a temporal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of ἀπεῖχον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7369.r: ἀπεῖχον “they were apart”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7370.n: TREE: ὅσον is adverbial, not attributive.
7370.r: ὅσον παρασάγγην “about a parasang”: ὅσον as an adverb, “about” [SMYTH:1609].

7371.n: TREE: παρασάγγην is an accusative of extent, not an object.
7371.r: ἀπεῖχον … παρασάγγην “were a parasang apart”: the accusative of extent of space [SMYTH:1581].

7373.r: The article makes Ἀσσύριοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7377.r: ἐστρατοπεδεύοντο “encamped”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. στρατοπεδεύομαι “encamp”: the subject pitches its own camp [SMYTH:1719]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7379.r: ὥσπερ εἴρηται “in the manner described”: the perfect passive [SMYTH:1945]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7382.r: ἐν περιτεταφρευμένῳ “in a place surrounded by a ditch”: ἐν with the dative of place, the participle used as a noun [PREP:ἐν] [SMYTH:2050]; passive [SMYTH:1735]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859].

7384.r: καταφανεῖ δέ “but open to view”: the dative of place, coordinate with περιτεταφρευμένῳ [PREP:ἐν] [CONV:D1].

7387.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

7391.r: ὡς ἐδύνατο “as … as possible”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. δύναμαι “be able” is middle-only and fits none of the middle types well; the case is still open [CONV:D3] [CONV:R3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7393.r: ὡς ἐδύνατο ἐν ἀφανεστάτῳ “in a place as much out of sight as possible”: ἐν with the dative of place [PREP:ἐν] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:199].

7400.n: TREE: ποιησάμενος goes with Cyrus’s understood ἐστρατοπεδεύετο, not with the Assyrians’ verb.
7400.r: κώμας … ἐπίπροσθεν ποιησάμενος “keeping under cover behind villages”: the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]; a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of the verb understood [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859].

7402.n: TREE: νομίζων goes with Cyrus’s understood verb.
7402.r: νομίζων “for he thought”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of the verb understood [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7403.r: Agrees with πολέμια and takes its case function [MORPH].

7404.r: The article makes πολέμια a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7405.n: TREE: πολέμια is the subject of εἶναι, not the object of ὁρώμενα.
7405.r: πάντα τὰ πολέμια … εἶναι “that all one’s equipment for war is”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:168].

7407.n: TREE: ὁρώμενα agrees with πολέμια; it is not the subject.
7407.r: ἐξαίφνης ὁρώμενα “if seen suddenly”: a conditional participle agreeing with πολέμια [SMYTH:2067]; passive [SMYTH:1735]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

7408.r: φοβερώτερα … εἶναι “inspires more terror”: the predicate of the infinitive, in the accusative [CONV:R5].

7409.r: The article makes ἐναντίοις a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7410.r: φοβερώτερα τοῖς ἐναντίοις “more terrible to the enemy”: the dative with an adjective [SMYTH:1481] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:168].

7411.r: νομίζων … εἶναι “thinking is”: νομίζω takes the declarative infinitive [SMYTH:2018]. Active voice [MORPH].

7415.r: Agrees with νύκτα and takes its case function [MORPH].

7417.r: Particular article: νύκτα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7418.r: ἐκείνην μὲν τὴν νύκτα “that night”: the accusative of duration of time [SMYTH:1582].

7420.r: ὥσπερ ἔπρεπε “as was proper”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7422.r: προφυλακὰς ποιησάμενοι “stationed advance guards and”: the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]; a temporal participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of ἐκοιμήθησαν [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859].

7424.r: ἐκοιμήθησαν “went to rest”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. κοιμάομαι “go to sleep, lie down”: a middle of change of bodily state [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7426.r: The article makes ὑστεραίᾳ a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7428.r: τῇ δʼ ὑστεραίᾳ “on the following day”: the dative of time [SMYTH:1540].

7429.r: The article makes Ἀσσύριος a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7433.r: Article with the proper name Κροῖσος [SMYTH:1136].

7436.r: Particular article: ἡγεμόνες is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7437.r: Agrees with ἡγεμόνες and takes its case function [MORPH].

7439.r: ἀνέπαυον “let rest”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7440.r: Particular article: στρατεύματα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7443.r: The article makes ἐχυρῷ a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7444.r: ἐν τῷ ἐχυρῷ “within the entrenchments”: ἐν with the dative of place [PREP:ἐν] [CONV:D1].

7450.r: συνταξάμενοι “in battle array”: the indirect middle, “draw up one’s forces” [SMYTH:1719]; a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of περιέμενον [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859].

7451.r: περιέμενον “awaited them”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7455.r: ὡς εἰ προσίοιεν “if the enemy should come on”: the optative of implied indirect discourse after a past tense [SMYTH:2619]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7456.r: The article makes πολέμιοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7459.r: ὡς … μαχούμενοι “ready to fight”: ὡς with the future participle of purpose [SMYTH:2086]. Agrees with the subject of περιέμενον [MORPH]. Future stem outside the indicative [SMYTH:1865]. μάχομαι “fight” is middle-only, a reciprocal middle of contending [CONV:D3].

7464.r: ὡς δὲ δῆλον ἐγένετο “when it was evident”: the aorist in a temporal clause [SMYTH:2383]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7467.n: TREE: ἐξίοιεν is from ἔξειμι (εἶμι); the tree reads ἐξιόω.
7467.r: ὅτι οὐκ ἐξίοιεν “that would not come out”: the optative in indirect discourse after a past tense [SMYTH:2619]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7468.r: The article makes πολέμιοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7471.r: Particular article: ἐρύματος is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7472.r: ἐκ τοῦ ἐρύματος “from behind their breastworks”: ἐκ with the genitive of separation [PREP:ἐκ] [CONV:D1].

7476.r: οὐδὲ μάχην ποιήσοιντο “nor accept battle”: the future optative in indirect discourse [SMYTH:2615]; the middle ποιοῦμαι with a verbal noun [SMYTH:1722]. Future stem outside the indicative [SMYTH:1865].

7478.n: TREE: ταύτῃ depends on ἡμέρα, not on ἐν as in the tree.
7478.r: ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ “that day”: ταύτῃ agrees with ἡμέρᾳ [SMYTH:1020].

7479.r: The article makes ἐν a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7480.n: TREE: the postag should be n-s---fd- (tree: n-s---fn-). TREE: ἡμέρᾳ is dative after ἐν, not a nominative subject.
7480.r: ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ “that day”: ἐν with the dative of time [PREP:ἐν] [CONV:D1].

7482.r: Article with the proper name Κυαξάρης [SMYTH:1136].

7485.r: καλέσας “called and”: a temporal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of ἔλεξε [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7486.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρον [SMYTH:1136].

7489.r: Particular article: ἄλλων is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7490.n: TREE: ἄλλων depends on ἐπικαιρίους, not on ἐπικαιρίους as in the tree.
7490.r: τῶν ἄλλων τοὺς ἐπικαιρίους “the staff officers besides”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

7491.r: The article makes ἐπικαιρίους a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7493.r: ἔλεξε “spoke”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7496.r: δοκεῖ μοι “I propose”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7497.r: δοκεῖ μοι “it seems good to me”: the dative with δοκεῖ [CONV:R18].

7499.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7505.r: ὥσπερ τυγχάνομεν “just as we are”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7506.r: τυγχάνομεν συντεταγμένοι “drawn up as we are”: the supplementary participle with τυγχάνω [SMYTH:2096] [CONV:R32]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Passive: the subject is acted on [SMYTH:1735].

7508.n: TREE: ἰέναι depends on δοκεῖ, not on τυγχάνομεν.
7508.r: δοκεῖ μοι … ἰέναι “I propose to march up”: the infinitive as subject of δοκεῖ [SMYTH:1985]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7510.r: Particular article: ἔρυμα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7511.r: πρὸς τὸ ἔρυμα “to the breastworks”: πρός with the accusative of direction [PREP:πρός] [CONV:D1].

7512.r: Particular article: ἀνδρῶν is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7513.r: τὸ ἔρυμα τῶν ἀνδρῶν “those fellows’ breastworks”: the possessive genitive [SMYTH:1297].

7515.r: καὶ δηλοῦν “and show”: the infinitive as subject of δοκεῖ [SMYTH:1985]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7517.r: ὅτι θέλομεν “that we are eager”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7518.r: θέλομεν μάχεσθαι “eager to fight”: ἐθέλω with the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:1991]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. μάχομαι “fight” is middle-only, a reciprocal middle of contending [CONV:D3].

7523.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7527.r: ἐὰν μὴ ἀντεπεξίωσιν “if they do not come out against us”: ἐάν with the subjunctive [SMYTH:2323]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7530.r: The article makes ἡμέτεροι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7534.r: μᾶλλον θαρρήσαντες “more full of courage”: a circumstantial participle, the ingressive aorist [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of ἀπίασιν [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7535.r: ἀπίασιν “will come back”: the present of εἶμι with future meaning [SMYTH:1880]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7537.r: The article makes πολέμιοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7540.r: Article with the abstract noun τόλμαν [SMYTH:1131].

7542.r: ἰδόντες “seeing”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of φοβήσονται [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7543.r: τὴν τόλμαν … ἡμῶν “our daring”: the subjective genitive [SMYTH:1330].

7545.r: φοβήσονται “will be frightened”: the future middle [SMYTH:1910]. φοβέομαι “fear” is a middle of emotion (mental process) [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7547.r: τούτῳ μὲν οὕτως ἐδόκει “such was his proposal”: the dative with δοκεῖ [CONV:R18].

7550.r: ἐδόκει “it seemed good”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7552.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

7558.r: ἔφη “said”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7561.r: Particular article: θεῶν is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

7562.r: πρὸς τῶν θεῶν “by the gods”: πρός with the genitive in entreaties [PREP:πρός] [SMYTH:1695].

7568.r: μηδαμῶς … οὕτω ποιήσωμεν “let us not do that; never”: the hortatory subjunctive with μή [SMYTH:1797]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7573.r: ἤδη ἐκφανέντες “show ourselves”: the passive aorist of ἐκφαίνομαι “appear” [SMYTH:1735]; a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of πορευσόμεθα [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859].

7574.r: εἰ … πορευσόμεθα “if we march out”: the future indicative in the protasis [SMYTH:2328]. πορεύομαι “march, go” is a middle of motion [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7578.r: ὡς σὺ κελεύεις “as you suggest”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7582.r: θεάσονται προσιόντας ἡμᾶς “will see us marching up”: the supplementary participle with a verb of perception [CONV:R4]. In indirect discourse the tense is that of the direct form [CONV:D7]. Active voice [MORPH].

7583.n: TREE: ἡμᾶς is the object of θεάσονται, not the subject of προσιόντας.
7583.r: προσιόντας ἡμᾶς … θεάσονται “will see us”: the object of a verb of perception with a supplementary participle [CONV:R4].

7584.r: The article makes πολέμιοι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7586.r: θεάσονται “they will see”: the future [SMYTH:1910]. θεάομαι “gaze at” is middle-only, a middle of perception [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7587.n: TREE: οὐδέν is adverbial, not an object.
7587.r: οὐδὲν φοβούμενοι “will have no fear”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

7613.r: τοῦ ἑαυτῶν “their own”: the reflexive possessive genitive with the article [SMYTH:1200].

7614.r: καταφρονήσουσι “will despise us”: the future [SMYTH:1910]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7618.r: αὔριον ἐξίασι “to-morrow they will come out”: the present of εἶμι with future meaning [SMYTH:1880]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7620.r: Agrees with γνώμαις and takes its case function [MORPH].

7621.r: Article with the abstract noun γνώμαις [SMYTH:1131].

7622.n: TREE: γνώμαις is a dative of manner, not an object.
7622.r: πολὺ ἐρρωμενεστέραις ταῖς γνώμαις “with much stouter hearts”: the dative of manner [SMYTH:1513].

7627.r: ἔφη “said he”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7641.r: εὖ τοῦτο ἐπίστω “be sure of this”: the imperative, parenthetical [SMYTH:1835] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:200]; ἐπίσταμαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

7656.r: περὶ ἡμῶν “about us”: περί with the genitive [PREP:περί] [CONV:R10].

7660.r: οὐδὲν παύονται “never cease”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

7661.r: παύονται “they cease”: the present [SMYTH:1875]; παύομαι “cease” [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7681.r: Direct object of εἰληφότας [MORPH]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

7686.r: λέξαντος δʼ οὕτω Κύρου “when Cyrus had thus spoken”: a temporal genitive absolute [SMYTH:2070]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7690.r: συνέδοξε “agreed with him”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7721.r: ἔθυε “prepared to sacrifice”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7738.r: ἐπεὶ δὲ τέλος εἶχεν “when was concluded”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7739.r: Article with the abstract noun θυσία [SMYTH:1131].

7742.r: συγκαλέσας “called together and”: a temporal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of ἔλεξεν [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7743.r: Direct object of συγκαλέσας [MORPH]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

7772.r: The article makes ἱεροῖς a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

7798.r: καὶ μεμελετηκότας “and have practised it”: the supplementary participle with οἶδα [CONV:R4]. In indirect discourse the tense is that of the direct form [CONV:D7]. Active voice [MORPH].

7800.r: καὶ ἀσκοῦντας “and have been continually training”: the supplementary participle with οἶδα [CONV:R4]. In indirect discourse the tense is that of the direct form [CONV:D7]. Active voice [MORPH].

7802.r: διὰ τέλους “continually”: διά with the genitive of time throughout [PREP:διά] [CONV:D1].

7803.r: Direct object of the verb understood [MORPH].

7819.r: εἰ μὴ τυγχάνετε “if you happen not”: the present in a simple condition [SMYTH:2298]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7831.r: πειρώμεθα “we are trying”: the present [SMYTH:1875]; πειράομαι “try” [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

7835.r: πειρώμεθα … ποιεῖν “are trying to make”: the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:1991]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

7840.r: δεῖ “we must”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9575.r: Particular article: κεφαλῶν is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

9576.r: ἀπὸ τῶν κεφαλῶν “from the ramparts”: ἀπό with the genitive of separation [PREP:ἀπό] [CONV:D1].

9577.n: TREE: τῶν depends on κεφαλῶν, not on κεφαλῶν as in the tree.
9577.r: τῶν κεφαλῶν τῶν ἔνδον “the inner ramparts”: the article makes the adverb attributive [SMYTH:1153].

9580.r: ἰδοῦσαι “seeing”: a temporal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2061]. Agrees with the subject of ἀνέκραγον [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

9582.r: Particular article: γυναῖκες is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

9583.n: TREE: γυναῖκες is the subject of ἀνέκραγον and ἔθεον.
9583.r: αἱ γυναῖκες “the women”: the subject of ἀνέκραγον [SMYTH:938].

9585.r: αἱ γυναῖκες τῶν Ἀσσυρίων “the women of the Assyrians”: the possessive genitive [SMYTH:1297].

9587.r: The article makes συμμάχων a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

9588.r: καὶ τῶν συμμάχων “and their allies”: the possessive genitive [SMYTH:1297].

9593.r: Particular article: στρατοπέδῳ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

9594.r: φυγὴν καὶ ἐν τῷ στρατοπέδῳ “flight even inside the camp”: ἐν with the dative of place [PREP:ἐν] [CONV:D1].

9595.r: ἀνέκραγον “raised a cry”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9600.r: αἱ μὲν … ἔχουσαι “those who had children”: the article with the participle [SMYTH:1153].

9606.r: αἱ δὲ καὶ νεώτεραι “and the younger women”: the article as a pronoun, in partitive apposition [SMYTH:1106].

9609.r: αἱ δὲ καὶ νεώτεραι “and the younger women as well”: in partitive apposition to γυναῖκες [SMYTH:981].

9611.n: TREE: the participle goes with the main verbs.
9611.r: καταρρηγνύμεναί τε πέπλους “while they rent their garments”: the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]; a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of ἀνέκραγον [MORPH]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

9615.n: TREE: the participle goes with the main verbs.

9618.n: TREE: the participle goes with the main verbs.

9642.r: Particular article: βασιλεῖς is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

9643.r: οἱ βασιλεῖς “the kings”: the subject of ἐμάχοντο [SMYTH:938].

9645.r: The article makes πιστοτάτοις a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

9646.r: Dative with σύν, “with”: accompaniment [PREP:σύν]; the tag gives the function of the phrase [CONV:D1].

9654.r: Particular article: κεφαλὰς is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

9658.r: ἐμάχοντο “fought”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. μάχομαι “fight” is middle-only, a reciprocal middle of contending [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9660.r: Particular article: ἄλλοις is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

9666.r: ὡς δʼ ἔγνω “when realized”: the aorist in a temporal clause [SMYTH:2383]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9667.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

9669.r: The article makes γιγνόμενα a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

9676.n: TREE: the condition goes with σφαλεῖεν.
9676.r: καὶ εἰ βιάσαιντο εἴσω “even if they did force their way in”: βιάζομαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]; the optative in a protasis within the fear clause [SMYTH:2329] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:212] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:178]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859].

9684.n: TREE: τι is adverbial, not an object.
9684.r: σφαλεῖέν τι “be worsted at all”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

9686.r: παρηγγύησεν “gave orders”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9689.r: παρηγγύησεν … ἀνάγειν “gave orders to retreat”: the infinitive after a verb of commanding [SMYTH:1992]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

9691.r: ἔξω βελῶν “out of range”: ἔξω with the genitive [CONV:R10].

9693.n: καὶ πείθεσθαι is bracketed in the text
9693.r: καὶ πείθεσθαι “and to obey”: the infinitive after a verb of commanding [SMYTH:1992] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:146]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. πείθομαι “obey, trust”: a middle of mental process; it can also be read as passive “be persuaded” [CONV:D3].

9697.r: ἔγνω τις ἄν “one might have seen”: the aorist indicative with ἄν of past potentiality [SMYTH:1784]. Active voice [MORPH].

9704.r: ὡς δεῖ “as they should be”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9710.r: ἐπείθοντο “they obeyed”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. πείθομαι “obey, trust”: a middle of mental process; it can also be read as passive “be persuaded” [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9712.r: ταχὺ δέ “and at once”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

9714.r: Particular article: ἄλλοις is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

9724.r: ἔστησαν “they halted”: the intransitive second aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9732.r: εἰδότες “for they knew”: a causal circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2064]. Agrees with the subject of ἔστησαν [MORPH]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

9734.r: ὅπου ἔδει “where should”: the imperfect, in an indirect question [SMYTH:2677]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

9737.r: ἔδει … γενέσθαι “should stand”: δεῖ with the infinitive [SMYTH:1985]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].
